episodes.title: Ronin
episodes.summary: When her young daughter is stricken by a mysterious malady, Ichika asks Yasuke to bring them upriver to a special doctor, but Yasuke refuses.

episodes.title: The Old Way
episodes.summary: Back in 1581, Yasuke and Natsumaru have become trusted warriors serving Nobunaga. In the present day, the mercenaries catch up to Yasuke and attack.

episodes.title: Mortal Sins
episodes.summary: Abraham sends Haruto and Nikita out to find Saki, who uses her growing powers to fight back. Under torture, Yasuke has a flashback to a betrayal.

episodes.title: A Long Road
episodes.summary: Back in the village, Saki asks Yasuke to bring her to Doctor Morisuke — and she won't take no for an answer. But there are new enemies in pursuit.

episodes.title: Pain & Blood
episodes.summary: While Morisuke protects Saki from the Daimyo's attack on the Astral Plane, Yasuke confronts the masked Dark General, who reveals their true identity.

episodes.title: Balance
episodes.summary: While Morisuke and his men create a protective shield around the temple, Yasuke and Saki face off with the Daimyo in Azuchi Castle.
